panels.title: TubePulse status
panels.description: A calm summary of service health, monitoring freshness and host authority. Saturated amber or coral appears only when action is required.

targets.expr: (tubepulse_collector_collection_success * tubepulse_collector_host_collection_success * tubepulse_host_ready * tubepulse_host_authority_current * tubepulse_host_scheduler_active * tubepulse_authority_backend_ready * tubepulse_notifications_barrier_healthy * (tubepulse_host_last_error_present == bool 0) * ((time() - tubepulse_collector_last_success_timestamp_seconds) < bool 960) * (scalar(sum(tubepulse_cloudflare_worker_errors{period="window"}) or vector(0)) == bool 0) * (scalar(tubepulse:d1_write_budget_ratio) < bool 0.9) * (scalar(tubepulse:worker_request_budget_ratio) < bool 0.9) * (scalar(max(tubepulse_youtube_quota_used / tubepulse_youtube_quota_limit)) < bool 0.9)) * (1 + (tubepulse_collector_cloudflare_collection_success * tubepulse_subscription_integrity_consistent * (tubepulse_authority_pending_backup_consecutive_samples < bool 2) * (tubepulse_authority_transaction_active_consecutive_samples < bool 2) * (tubepulse_notifications_durable_backlog == bool 0) * (tubepulse_notifications_callback_pending == bool 0) * (tubepulse_notifications_ambiguous_sending == bool 0) * (tubepulse_notifications_retained_failures == bool 0) * (tubepulse_notifications_failed == bool 0) * (tubepulse_youtube_last_error_present == bool 0) * (tubepulse_live_watch_degraded == bool 0) * ((time() - tubepulse_collector_last_success_timestamp_seconds) < bool 660) * (scalar(tubepulse:d1_write_budget_ratio) < bool 0.7) * (scalar(tubepulse:d1_read_budget_ratio) < bool 0.7) * (scalar(tubepulse:d1_write_projected_end_of_day / on() tubepulse_guardrail{resource="d1_rows_written_day"}) < bool 0.7) * (scalar(tubepulse:worker_request_budget_ratio) < bool 0.7) * (scalar(max(tubepulse_youtube_quota_used / tubepulse_youtube_quota_limit)) < bool 0.7) * (scalar(sum(tubepulse_cloudflare_worker_requests{period="window",script!="tubepulse-api"}) or vector(0)) == bool 0)))

panels.title: Data freshness
panels.description: Age of the latest successful monitoring sample. Amber begins at 11 minutes; coral begins at 16 minutes.

panels.title: Host authority
panels.description: Confirms that this host remains the current public authority and backend is ready.

panels.title: Attention
panels.description: Quiet when no action is required. Current queues, transactions, drift, API failures, notification failures, Worker errors or legacy traffic appear here only when actionable.

targets.expr: tubepulse_host_last_error_present + (tubepulse_authority_pending_backup_consecutive_samples >= bool 2) + (tubepulse_authority_transaction_active_consecutive_samples >= bool 2) + (1 - tubepulse_subscription_integrity_consistent) + tubepulse_youtube_last_error_present + tubepulse_live_watch_degraded + (tubepulse_notifications_failed > bool 0) + (tubepulse_notifications_durable_backlog > bool 0) + (tubepulse_notifications_callback_pending > bool 0) + (tubepulse_notifications_ambiguous_sending > bool 0) + (scalar(sum(tubepulse_cloudflare_worker_errors{period="window"}) or vector(0)) > bool 0) + (scalar(sum(tubepulse_cloudflare_worker_requests{period="window",script!="tubepulse-api"}) or vector(0)) > bool 0) + 1000 * (1 - (tubepulse_collector_collection_success * tubepulse_collector_host_collection_success * tubepulse_host_ready * tubepulse_host_authority_current * tubepulse_host_scheduler_active * tubepulse_authority_backend_ready * tubepulse_notifications_barrier_healthy * (tubepulse_host_last_error_present == bool 0) * ((time() - tubepulse_collector_last_success_timestamp_seconds) < bool 960) * (scalar(sum(tubepulse_cloudflare_worker_errors{period="window"}) or vector(0)) == bool 0) * (scalar(tubepulse:d1_write_budget_ratio) < bool 0.9) * (scalar(tubepulse:worker_request_budget_ratio) < bool 0.9) * (scalar(max(tubepulse_youtube_quota_used / tubepulse_youtube_quota_limit)) < bool 0.9)))

(1 - (tubepulse_collector_collection_success * tubepulse_collector_host_collection_success * tubepulse_host_ready * tubepulse_host_authority_current * tubepulse_host_scheduler_active * tubepulse_authority_backend_ready * tubepulse_notifications_barrier_healthy * (tubepulse_host_last_error_present == bool 0) * ((time() - tubepulse_collector_last_success_timestamp_seconds) < bool 960) * (scalar(sum(tubepulse_cloudflare_worker_errors{period="window"}) or vector(0)) == bool 0) * (scalar(tubepulse:d1_write_budget_ratio) < bool 0.9) * (scalar(tubepulse:worker_request_budget_ratio) < bool 0.9) * (scalar(max(tubepulse_youtube_quota_used / tubepulse_youtube_quota_limit)) < bool 0.9))) > 0

panels.title: Audience & scale
panels.description: Aggregate audience activity and service scale. These are context metrics, not fault thresholds.

panels.title: Backend seen 24h
panels.description: Unique installations with a successful authenticated backend contact in the rolling 24-hour window, including notification taps that invoke /seen. Passive notification delivery alone is not counted. Aggregate context only; this is not a fault threshold.

panels.title: Capacity
panels.description: Current and projected resource use against configured guardrails. Cyan is comfortable; amber and coral are reserved for genuine capacity risk.

panels.title: Service traffic · 24h
panels.description: Aggregate Worker requests in finalized five-minute windows. Disconnected clients are context rather than service failure.

panels.title: Database activity · 24h
panels.description: D1 rows read and written in delayed, finalized five-minute Cloudflare analytics windows.

panels.title: Notification delivery · 24h
panels.description: Aggregate delivery outcomes from recent notification cycles. Coral failures and amber backlog remain quiet unless non-zero.
